column1: # Issue #144 item 3, shipped-artifact binding. Rules about the release products themselves, not
# about a probe build. `render-entry` requires an exported entry that is defined exactly once and
# whose direct and GOT-indirect call closure reaches at least `floor` functions. `kernel-host`
# names a production function that instantiates lane kernels, and requires it to be defined exactly
# once, to perform at least `floor` vector arithmetic instructions at the backend width, to be
# vector dominated (strictly more vector than scalar arithmetic), and to call no math library.
# The floors are deliberately well below the observed counts: this report discriminates "the shipped
# bank is a scalar loop in bank clothing", not a compiler's instruction-selection drift. Observed
# counts are in the report so drift stays visible without gating on it.
